# Minecraft Fabric AP v1.2.0

Releasing a build with the fixes and improvements we've done so far before we get around to implementing major new content in the next update.

## Improvements

* Added several new logic options to make the first few spheres of itemsanity more playable
    * Added options to logically integrate Nature's Compass and Explorer's Compass, locking items that require specific
      biomes or structures behind the ability to search for them with the compass mods
    * Added options to make movement abilities (jump, sprint, swim) and the ability to sleep to set your spawn point
      logically required for checks that require exploration
* Finished implementing the Totem of Meteorology, a custom item that allows players to quickly change the weather
* Changed the APWorld logic entirely to use the RuleBuilder library

## Fixes

### Mod
* Prevented mod persistent state from accumulating duplicate advancement IDs
* Fixed thread race error in checking advancement criteria
* Client now batches location check packets sent to Archipelago server
* Added a failsafe to prevent hard crashes due to a missing mod
* Fixed several typos that allowed certain items to be crafted without the required progression

### APWorld
* Enchanting now logically requires diamonds to craft an Enchanting Table
